name: jpchauny-plugins
description: Shared Claude Code plugins for working in three layers: specifications (people), norms (generated), code (agents)

plugins.name: shared
plugins.description: How the team works: explore before specifying or building; pending items and findings go to GitHub issues, each with a self-contained hand-off; explanations one step at a time, waiting for the user's got-it

plugins.name: specs
plugins.description: Layer 1 tools for the people who write a project's specifications in plain prose: readability, renumbering chapters, reviewing a change

plugins.name: norms
plugins.description: Layer 2: the norms generator common to every project (annotates layer 1 with stable IDs), and the method and tools for writing a project's own generators of derived specifications

plugins.name: code
plugins.description: Layer 3: the implementation method; code and tests built only from a pinned version of layer 2, citing its norm IDs, and every inconsistency sent back to layer 1

plugins.name: new-project
plugins.description: Start a new project from scratch: asks for its name, creates its three repositories (<project>-specs, <project>-norms, <project>-code), enables in each the plugins of its layer, and writes the initial documents

plugins.name: recap
plugins.description: Get back into a Claude Code session after time away: a short report of the session it is invoked from - its goal, what was done, the decisions taken, and what is pending to do or decide
